Mark the "Open Parties and Claims" mod as potentially conflicting

The mod's default claim restrictions are severe enough to break basic automation interactions, like spreaders shooting mana bursts.

Improve mana burst handling of potentially unloaded chunks

- bursts track their source dimension so they don't attempt to look at a completely unrelated position in a different dimension when looking for their source spreader
- redirective lens can only operate in its source dimension, and only if its source spreader is still loaded
- warp lens adds a "post-teleport" chunk loading ticket when the burst is teleported via a force relay, similar to entities traveling through an end gateway (this does not enable block entity ticking on its own)
- bore-warp lens can only teleport items in its source dimension; it adds a "post-teleport" chunk loading ticket when teleporting items to the source spreader
- Spectranthemum-teleported items also add that ticket, while we're at it

Improve may-interact checks for mana bursts

- lenses that have an effect on the world will now check if the burst is allowed to actually affect the world at that position (e.g. spawn protection area)
- lenses that remove blocks will do so in a way that includes a reference to the burst entity, in case anything wants to reference it back to a player (exception: laputa shard block moving bursts)
- Manastorm Epicenter entity inherits the owner of the burst that ignited it, which is passed on to all bursts spawned by the manastorm (vague TNT parity)
